summary: Father Andrew discusses accusations leveled against Orthodox Christians regarding icon veneration, arguing that it is not idolatry but rather honoring those through whom God manifests His presence. He explains how the Seventh Ecumenical Council addressed this issue by affirming depictions of Christ and saints as reflections of God's incarnation, emphasizing that veneration directed towards icons ultimately honors God Himself. Ultimately, belief in the Incarnation necessitates acknowledging God’s presence within creation.
